title: 1982 AHSME Problem 16
statement: In the adjoining figure, a wooden cube has edges of length \(3\) meters. Square holes of side one meter, centered in each face, are cut through to the opposite face. The edges of the holes are parallel to the edges of the cube. The entire surface area including the inside, in square meters, is

solutions.text:
The six outer faces contribute \(6(3^2-1^2)=48.\) Each of the three length-\(3\) square tunnels has four inner walls, but the central unit segment of every wall is removed by a perpendicular tunnel, leaving area \(2\) per wall. Thus the inside contributes \(3\cdot4\cdot2=24.\) The total is \(48+24=72.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: Start with the outer faces after removing their central squares
For each of the three tunnels, count the four interior walls not removed by the crossing tunnels
